Not only is the skin edible, but it gives off a rather nice aroma as well.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Roasted Hearty Salmons are a type of [[Roasted Food]], being the result of [[Hearty Salmon]]s that have been exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} They have a nice aroma and edible skin. [[Blue Hinox]]es sometimes drop them when killed by [[Link]]. Eating one restores four and a half [[Heart]]s to Link's [[Life Gauge]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Roasted Hearty Salmons reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Hearty Salmon]]s to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They have a nice aroma and edible skin. Eating one restores four and a half of Link's [[Heart]]s. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Frozen Hearty Salmon * Hearty Salmon * Roasted Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
